title: Natural evaluation-normalized currying for bounded localization complexes
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, U an object, f a section on U and S_f the slice localization coefficient [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-localization-complex-models]. For every bounded complex P with terms finite coproducts of section localizations and every unbounded derived N, the component modelCurryIso(S_f,P,N) gives the specified currying isomorphism RHom(S_f[0],RHom(P|U,N|U))≅RHom(S_f tensor P|U,N|U) [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-model-currying]. This is natural simultaneously in arbitrary chain maps of P and arbitrary derived morphisms of N, with precisely the source and target maps in the parent statement. Its equality with the supplied model comparison is definitional.

proof.text: Apply the shared model comparison to the localization coefficient and the proved coefficient and restricted-complex K-flat certificates. Its simultaneous naturality gives the desired equation. The equality with modelCurryIso is definitional, so the model coherence assertion applies to exactly this family.

lean.statement:
theorem curryIso_natural (U : C) (f : R.obj.obj (op U))
    (P P' : CochainComplex (localizationModules R) ℤ)
    (hP : IsBoundedLocalizationComplex R P) (hP' : IsBoundedLocalizationComplex R P')
    (a : P' ⟶ P) (N N' : localizationDerived R) (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (curryIso R U f P hP N).hom ≫ (localizationRHom (R.over U)).map
      (((localizationQ (R.over U)).map ((localizationSliceComplex R U f).map a)).op,
        (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).map b) =
    (localizationRHom (R.over U)).map
      (𝟙 (op (localizationSliceDerivedCoefficient R U f)),
        (localizationRHom (R.over U)).map
          (((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).map ((localizationQ R).map a)).op,
            (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).map b)) ≫
      (curryIso R U f P' hP' N').hom
